abstract: Maintains bathymetric sonar tracking records, debris field maps, and vertical depth accuracy logs
system_message:
You are the Chief Hydrographic Surveyor (CHS). Your responsibilities include maintaining bathymetric sonar tracking records, debris field maps, vertical depth accuracy logs, and tidal flow monitoring across the harbor wreck site.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tidal flow monitoring（TIDE）
information_points.content:
CHS-TIDE-3KK：Under the High-capacity pneumatic caisson refloatation salvage plan, tidal flow monitoring records a peak ebb-tide current velocity of 2.4 kn across the main navigation fairway seabed sill.
CHS-TIDE-382：Under the Twin-barge semi-submersible sheerleg lift salvage plan, tidal flow monitoring records a peak ebb-tide current velocity of 3.1 kn across the main navigation fairway seabed sill.
CHS-TIDE-G20：Under the Rotational parabolic parbuckling salvage plan, tidal flow monitoring records a peak ebb-tide current velocity of 1.8 kn across the main navigation fairway seabed sill.

information_points.title: Maintains bathymetric sonar tracking records, debris field maps, and vertical depth accuracy logs（BATHY）
information_points.content:
CHS-BATHY-AS7：For the High-capacity pneumatic caisson refloatation salvage plan, active side-scan sonar survey deployment is confirmed operational (true), while the seafloor debris mapping depth deviation across the primary wreck debris footprint and anchor corridors is 0.4 m.
CHS-BATHY-PVR：For the Twin-barge semi-submersible sheerleg lift salvage plan, active side-scan sonar survey deployment is active (true) on the salvage grid, and the seafloor debris mapping depth deviation measured across the primary wreck debris footprint and anchor corridors is 0.6 m.
CHS-BATHY-OVC：For the Rotational parabolic parbuckling salvage plan, active side-scan sonar survey deployment is active (true) according to the survey vessel acoustic towfish deployment log, and the seafloor debris mapping depth deviation across the primary wreck debris footprint and immediate anchor corridors is 0.2 m.
